title: Software Developer Apprentice
description:
Skills Required

* Basic Java or Python
* HTML, CSS, JavaScript
* SQL fundamentals
* Git/GitHub
* Basic understanding of REST APIs
* Problem-solving skills

What the apprentice will do

* Develop and maintain web applications
* Work with senior developers on real projects
* Build and test APIs
* Write SQL queries
* Fix bugs and improve existing features
* Participate in code reviews
* Learn industry development practices

Training Provided

During the 12-month apprenticeship, the candidate will receive practical training in:

Month 1–2:
Programming + Git + Development fundamentals

Month 3–5:
Backend/API development + databases

Month 6–8:
Real project development

Month 9–11:
Advanced development + testing + deployment

Month 12:
Final project + evaluation

Selection Process

Application → Resume Screening → Technical Assessment → Technical Interview → HR Interview → Apprenticeship Onboarding

Full-Time Opportunity

Successful apprentices may be considered for a full-time Software Developer position based on performance, business requirements and applicable company policies.

title: AI / Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are hiring an AI / Machine Learning Engineer to design and deploy state-of-the-art machine learning models and LLM solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
- Build, train, and evaluate machine learning models using PyTorch, TensorFlow, and scikit-learn.
- Optimize deep learning inference pipelines for production deployment.
- Integrate LLM APIs, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and vector databases.
- Perform data preprocessing, feature engineering, and SQL analytics.
- Collaborate with cloud platform engineers to deploy ML pipelines on AWS and Docker containers.

Requirements & Skills:
- Deep expertise in Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Computer Vision / NLP algorithms.
- Solid understanding of SQL, REST APIs, Docker, and AWS cloud infrastructure.
- Strong mathematical background in Linear Algebra, Calculus, and Probability.
eligibility: B.Tech / M.Tech in CS / AI / Data Science

description:
Architect and manage robust cloud infrastructure and automated CI/CD pipelines for our global microservices architecture.

Key Responsibilities:
- Provision and maintain scalable AWS cloud environments using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
- Manage Docker containers and Kubernetes clusters across staging and production.

- Monitor system reliability, uptime, and security metrics using Prometheus and Grafana.

Requirements & Skills:
- Advanced skills in AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, and Terraform.
- Scripting knowledge in Python, Bash, and Shell.
